name: mci-einvoice-form
description: UAE e-invoicing customer data collection (token-link form + admin panel) — MERN + TypeScript

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:rules && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.sync:rules: cp backend/src/utils/rules.ts frontend/src/lib/rules.ts && echo 'Copied backend rules.ts to frontend'
scripts.check:rules: cmp -s backend/src/utils/rules.ts frontend/src/lib/rules.ts && echo 'rules.ts in sync' || (echo 'rules.ts differs between backend and frontend: run npm run sync:rules' && exit 1)
